facts.fact: ACP reported that on 1 November 2024 ANICNS handed the Centre Hospitalier Universitaire Renaissance in Kinshasa 20 computers, 20 tablets and 5 routers for 40 digitised workstations, which its director general said would also allow an ANICNS-approved hospital information system to be put into service and ease portability of the computerised patient record; the system is described as to come, not as running.
facts.system: Système d'Information Hospitalier (SIH) homologué par l'ANICNS

facts.fact: ACP describes ANICNS, which approves the hospital information system, as a public establishment of a scientific and technical character charged with setting up and coordinating the digital system for universal health coverage and with digital governance of that coverage; the document does not name the ministry itself, and the date is the document's.
facts.system: Système d'Information Hospitalier (SIH) homologué par l'ANICNS
